description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag StoreFooterTag that generates a footer string for a web store, including store name and operational years, by accessing request attributes and formatting date information.

classes.name: StoreFooterlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class to generate a footer containing the store name and operational years.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the footer string with store name and years based on merchant store data and writes it to the page output.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the custom tag processing, indicating to evaluate the rest of the page.
